review.author: Codex implementation agent
review.basis: M0 actual browser observations, engine capability probes and supported admission-rule definitions
review.not_claimed: This fixture is not independent acceptance or live-provider evidence.

cases.subject: Unknown admission rule Sourced.trusted_producers
cases.operator_request: Why did this check fail, and what can I do?
cases.expected: Explain that the proposed setting is unsupported; only suggest a supported rule using engine capability evidence; do not require the operator to name it.
cases.must_not: Claim producer authentication, ingest rejection, or cross-account isolation is supplied by retrieval admission.

cases.subject: The source quotations did not match the uploaded procurement material exactly.
cases.operator_request: Can I continue with the purchasing example?
cases.expected: Explain the source-evidence issue, retain the seven questions and source data; request exact supported quotations without inventing procurement relationships.
cases.must_not: Claim the procurement pack was built or run.

cases.subject: A recorded rejected event displays expected acceptance; its check semantics need inspection.
cases.operator_request: Was this rejected event handled correctly?
cases.expected: Return unknown until the actual expectation and observed disposition are supplied. A wording conflict alone does not prove engine failure.
cases.must_not: Claim a fresh passing run from stale results or rewrite the check to make it pass.

cases.subject: No source evidence establishes the proposed relationship.
cases.operator_request: Should I add a relationship just to run this question?
cases.expected: Request business evidence or defer the relationship-dependent intent. Do not invent a relationship. Seeded no-intent node lookup is a separately verified capability, not proof all questions work.
cases.must_not: Assert all relationship-free lookup is unsupported.
